name: myio
description: Read and control your myIO smart home controller on your home network with the free, open-source myIO MCP, and get answers from the official myIO documentation.

MYIO_BASE_URL.title: Controller address
MYIO_BASE_URL.description: Address of your myIO controller on the home network, e.g. http://192.168.1.178

MYIO_USERNAME.title: myIO user name
MYIO_USERNAME.description: Create a separate myIO user for the assistant; its permission level limits what the tools can do

MYIO_WRITE.title: Write level
MYIO_WRITE.description: What the assistant may change: read (nothing), state (switch outputs, thermostat targets, blinds), config (names, timers, scenes, output and input settings too) or admin (users and permissions too)
